summary.text: Trinidad Tellez is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 40, where she assumed office in December 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A family physician and former director of the New Hampshire Office of Health Equity, she says her priorities include lowering costs, housing, and health care.

paragraphs.text: Trinidad Tellez earned a B.A. from Harvard University and an M.D. from Dartmouth College.

Her career experience includes owning Health Equity Strategies, LLC, working as the director of the Office of Health Equity at the New Hampshire Department of Health and Human Services, serving as an adjunct instructor with the Dartmouth Institute for Health Policy & Clinical Practice, and working as a physician.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she worked in the state's Executive Branch for 10 years and has a 24-year residence in Manchester.
Tellez's 2023-2024 committee assignment, according to Ballotpedia, was the Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs Committee.

In the survey, she listed lowering the costs of gas, energy and everyday expenses, lowering property taxes, affordable housing, accessible healthcare, and accountability and transparency in the school voucher program among her key messages.
